subject: Copywriting
title: Influencer Propaganda
description: A short lesson to help you apply Influencer Propaganda.

buildup.text: A 2023 survey showed 69% of consumers trust influencer recommendations over brand advertising.

twist.text: FTC rules require influencers to disclose paid partnerships.

climax.text: Influencer propaganda is effective because it feels authentic.

punchline.text: 69% trust influencers over brands. Authenticity is the new propaganda channel.

quiz.question: What percentage of consumers trust influencer recommendations over brand ads?
